items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Now you take, the old man he used to play with Peter Port.

ctx.x: I knew Johnny, I knew Johnny but I never knew Herbert. But Herbert was still in Chicago a few years ago and I couldn't find him. Yeah. I tried to find him in 1958, six years ago. Yeah. And he was still there. He owned him. He might be dead now but he was there. No. I told you who saw him, you remember some singers, Mack and Mack? Mack and Mack, yeah. They were still up there and they said they saw him at a grocery store every once in a while but when they tried to find him they didn't see him. I was only there a…
Now you take, the old man he used to play with Peter Port.
Oh yeah. The old man Lindsey. What was his name? I didn't know his name. The old man, do you remember? The old man Lindsey?
